content: अनंश {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Not entitled to a share in the inheritance; ˚शौ क्लीबपतितौ जात्यन्धबधिरौ तथा . उन्मत्तजडमूकाश्च ये च केचिन्निरिन्द्रियाः .. <ls>Ms. 9. 201</ls>. Other persons are also mentioned by Devala, Baudhāyana, Kātyāyana and Nārada. .²2 Without parts, undivided, portionless; an epithet of the sky or the Supreme Being.
